questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Let Sₙ = a + ar + ar² + ... + ar^(n-1) with r ≠ 1. Derive Sₙ = a(1 - rⁿ)/(1 - r).
questions.prompt_markup: Let Sₙ = a + ar + ar² + ... + ar^(n-1) with r ≠ 1. Derive Sₙ = a(1 - rⁿ)/(1 - r).
questions.correct_answer: Sₙ - rSₙ = a - arⁿ, so (1 - r)Sₙ = a(1 - rⁿ) and Sₙ = a(1 - rⁿ)/(1 - r).
questions.required_method: Write rSₙ, subtract it from Sₙ, and divide by 1 - r.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof or derivation. Essential: rSₙ = ar + ar² + ... + arⁿ; all middle terms cancel in Sₙ - rSₙ; factor (1 - r); divide, which needs r ≠ 1. Invalid: checking the formula for one or two values of n.

questions.prompt: Explain why the derivation of Sₙ = a(1 - rⁿ)/(1 - r) does not work when r = 1, and find Sₙ in that case.
questions.prompt_markup: Explain why the derivation of Sₙ = a(1 - rⁿ)/(1 - r) does not work when r = 1, and find Sₙ in that case.
questions.correct_answer: The last step divides by 1 - r = 0; when r = 1 every term is a, so Sₙ = na.
